facts.fact_text: In 2009-14, the applicants lodged notices of LGBT public assemblies as indicated in the Appendix.
In each instance, the local authorities refused to approve the dates proposed by the applicants for the LGBT public assemblies.
In each instance, the local authorities refused to approve the locations proposed by the applicants for the LGBT public assemblies.
The applicants challenged the local authorities' refusal decisions in the domestic courts under Chapter 25 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
The domestic courts upheld the decisions of the local authorities refusing to approve the dates and locations of the LGBT public assemblies.
